> **Reading these numbers honestly:** the pure-Python backend (kyber-py +
> dilithium-py) is a correct, portable *reference* implementation, not an
> optimised one. Even so, ML-KEM/ML-DSA **keygen is already faster than
> RSA-2048 keygen** here. Its **sign/verify look slower than RSA only because
> the Python reference code is unoptimised** — the native `liboqs` backend
> (`pip install pqcmap[liboqs]`) runs the same operations orders of magnitude
> faster and typically beats RSA on sign as well. Re-run this script with
> liboqs installed to see the production numbers on your hardware.
